channel.title: Pier & Point · Third Street Garage
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Third Street Garage (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Third Street Garage: The Third Street Garage showed a 2004 construction start and a 2005 completion that were only ever a 2003 projection. Those milestones were removed; the projection is still described, and the garage's completed status now rests on a 2021 report that its original facade was removed in 2015.

item.title: Correction · Third Street Garage: The 2021 facade replacement was wrong: Facades+ (March 2021) says the channel-glass facade was removed in 2015 and IwamotoScott's new facade was completed in January 2020, so the record now shows both. The November 2003 Regents item requests approval of the $23,298,000 budget and does not record the vote, so the record and the related timeline entry now say it was submitted for approval. The March 2004 construction start and July 2005 completion are the 2003 item's plan and are marked expected (no report of the actual dates was found). The map caveat no longer says UCSF land has no Assessor parcel (the footprint is inside active parcel 8711509), the capacity note now cites the contractor's 882 stalls, and the aerial photo caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'.

item.title: Milestone · Third Street Garage: IwamotoScott's 'Cellular Origami' facade of white anodized metal panels is completed on the garage (Facades+, March 15, 2021: 'Completion Date: January 2020'), replacing the original channel-glass facade, which the same article says was removed in 2015 (Jan 2020)

item.title: Complete · Third Street Garage: Original channel-glass facade removed from the garage, 'leaving the building barren with worn and exposed concrete' (Facades+, March 15, 2021), so the garage was standing by 2015; no source read reports when it was first completed (~2015)

item.title: Milestone · Third Street Garage: UC Regents' Committee on Grounds and Buildings and Committee on Finance are asked to approve a $23,298,000 budget, to be funded from external financing, for the Mission Bay Building 23B Parking Structure Project (822 spaces on nine levels plus 52 surface spaces, Block 23); the item, dated November 6, 2003, requests approval and does not record the vote; it says construction is slated to begin in March 2004 and to be completed by July 2005 (Nov 19, 2003)
